additionalInspected.caption: Pacific Park at the Santa Monica Pier in California.
additionalInspected.inspection: 2021 full original individually inspected. Current wheel white paired rim/trusses, exposed radial spokes, alternating red/yellow eight-sided gondola baskets with dark flat canopy/corner posts. A-frames grounded on deck with low loading area, yellow coaster beams/rails and colored support columns. People excluded.

additionalInspected.caption: Santa Monica Pier
additionalInspected.inspection: 2025 full original individually inspected. Current yellow hip-roof restaurant with central square open roof well, seaward twin stairs/low lower platform/teal rails and white harbor office/mast. Long straight neck, broad park/wheel outline and carousel roof visible shoreward.

additionalInspected.caption: Santa Monica Pier in California
additionalInspected.inspection: 2021 full original individually inspected. Carousel peach walls, dark blue cornices/frames, seven lower arched bays/paired upper arches, octagonal corner towers with pointed upper lights. Swept concave grey tent roof and dark blue ventilated polygonal cupola with shallow cap; NO onion dome.

additionalInspected.caption: The Santa Monica Looff Hippodrome - the historic Victorian era main building on the Santa Monica Pier.
additionalInspected.artist: Richard Wang took this photo and has released it under the GDFL.
additionalInspected.inspection: 2005 full native carousel facade individually inspected. Arched lower door/windows actual setbacks/transoms/fanlights, paired upper arched windows, tower pointed lights, stepped blue cornices and restrained cream/peach stucco. Original stripped historic domes/crenellations not reconstructed.

sources.inspection: Primary NPS nomination section7 read. Square2-story frame carousel shelter/arched lower bays/paired upper windows and corner towers. Describes original domes and tent roof; modern local photographs control retained roof. Historical dates/ornament descriptions not blindly substituted for current built form.

Preservation body description read: retained octagonal towers on THREE corners and pointed upper windows/cupola, much original ornament stripped. Selected photo-era current shape excludes original onion dome and12 smaller historic towers. Exact unseen facade details remain proportional estimates.

Operator description read. New wheel introducedMay2008, current85ft/26m wheel and2016lighting update. Pre2008 images not used for present gondola details. Solar panels are on park building roofs. Static geometry only.

Operator current85ft size conflicts with wording130ft above pier; use photo-proportioned approximately26m overall ride rather than inflating diameter/pedestal to130ft. Twenty gondola stations counted from current image; open radial trusses retained.

Aerial actually inspected. SW municipal axis, south broad amusement/parking platform, carousel at landward end separate from bridge/city. Current park massing and neck/head preserved; surrounding city and bridge approach beyond pier outline excluded.

scope: Combined pier deck/supports/rails, historic carousel, static wheel/coaster and main integral roof masses/head buildings; no ride simulation, people/vehicles, beach/city blocks or bridge replacement.
limitations: Selected2005–2025 surviving exterior; local images from multiple dates disagree in movable fixtures/colors/park tents. Post2008 wheel and2021 stripped carousel roof are controls. No historical lost domes/attractions or future bridge proposal.
Map footprint is generalized OSM. Roof/facade/rail/pile dimensions, unseen faces, marine foundations and exact tide/seabed are original proportional estimates. No photo pixels embedded.

Four original Terrarium tiles retained unchanged. Dry beach path reference datum5.706m,17m sampled review grid. Deck3m/fixed piles-10m and lower head landing1.4m are bounded authoring estimates. Full native outline sampled-6.604..+.706m relative to dry grade, below deck; terrain is not adjusted. Elevated bridge beyond bounded pier excluded.
